parameters.command:
=su - oracle -c "sqlplus -s / as sysdba <<EOF
set pages 300
set lines 400
set define off
set trimspool on
set sqlblanklines on

/* =========================
   TABLESPACE SUMMARY
   ========================= */
SELECT
    'TABLESPACE'                              AS row_type,
    d.tablespace_name                         AS tablespace,
    NULL                                      AS datafile,
    ROUND(d.curr/1024/1024, 2)                AS current_size_mb,
    ROUND((d.curr - f.free)/1024/1024, 2)     AS used_mb,
    ROUND(f.free/1024/1024, 2)                AS free_mb,
    ROUND(((d.curr - f.free)/d.curr) * 100,2) AS used_percent,
    ROUND(d.max/1024/1024, 2)                 AS max_size_mb,
    NULL                                      AS autoextend
FROM
(
    SELECT tablespace_name,
           SUM(bytes) AS curr,
           SUM(DECODE(autoextensible,'YES',maxbytes,bytes)) AS max
    FROM dba_data_files
    GROUP BY tablespace_name
) d
JOIN
(
    SELECT tablespace_name,
           SUM(bytes) AS free
    FROM dba_free_space
    GROUP BY tablespace_name
) f
ON d.tablespace_name = f.tablespace_name

UNION ALL

/* =========================
   DATAFILE DETAIL
   ========================= */
SELECT
    'DATAFILE'                               AS row_type,
    df.tablespace_name                       AS tablespace,
    df.file_name                             AS datafile,
    ROUND(df.bytes/1024/1024, 2)             AS current_size_mb,
    ROUND((df.bytes - NVL(fs.free_bytes,0))/1024/1024, 2)
                                             AS used_mb,
    ROUND(NVL(fs.free_bytes,0)/1024/1024, 2)
                                             AS free_mb,
    ROUND(((df.bytes - NVL(fs.free_bytes,0)) / df.bytes) * 100, 2)
                                             AS used_percent,
    ROUND(DECODE(df.autoextensible,'YES',df.maxbytes,df.bytes)
         /1024/1024, 2)
                                             AS max_size_mb,
    df.autoextensible                        AS autoextend
FROM dba_data_files df
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        file_id,
        SUM(bytes) AS free_bytes
    FROM dba_free_space
    GROUP BY file_id
) fs
ON df.file_id = fs.file_id

ORDER BY tablespace, row_type DESC, datafile;

exit
EOF"

=su - oraerpp <<'EOF'
sqlplus -s / as sysdba <<'SQL'
set pages 300
set lines 400
set define off
set trimspool on
set sqlblanklines on

/* =========================
   TABLESPACE SUMMARY
   ========================= */
SELECT
    'TABLESPACE'                              AS row_type,
    d.tablespace_name                         AS tablespace,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(400))               AS datafile,
    ROUND(d.curr/1024/1024, 2)                AS current_size_mb,
    ROUND((d.curr - f.free)/1024/1024, 2)     AS used_mb,
    ROUND(f.free/1024/1024, 2)                AS free_mb,
    ROUND(((d.curr - f.free)/d.curr) * 100,2) AS used_percent,
    ROUND(d.max/1024/1024, 2)                 AS max_size_mb,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(3))                 AS autoextend
FROM
(
    SELECT tablespace_name,
           SUM(bytes) AS curr,
           SUM(DECODE(autoextensible,'YES',maxbytes,bytes)) AS max
    FROM dba_data_files
    GROUP BY tablespace_name
) d
JOIN
(
    SELECT tablespace_name,
           SUM(bytes) AS free
    FROM dba_free_space
    GROUP BY tablespace_name
) f
ON d.tablespace_name = f.tablespace_name

UNION ALL

/* =========================
   DATAFILE DETAIL (ของเดิมคุณ)
   ========================= */
SELECT
    'DATAFILE'                               AS row_type,
    df.tablespace_name                       AS tablespace,
    df.file_name                             AS datafile,
    ROUND(df.bytes/1024/1024, 2)             AS current_size_mb,
    ROUND((df.bytes - NVL(fs.free_bytes,0))/1024/1024, 2)
                                             AS used_mb,
    ROUND(NVL(fs.free_bytes,0)/1024/1024, 2)
                                             AS free_mb,
    ROUND(((df.bytes - NVL(fs.free_bytes,0)) / df.bytes) * 100, 2)
                                             AS used_percent,
    ROUND(DECODE(df.autoextensible,'YES',df.maxbytes,df.bytes)
         /1024/1024, 2)
                                             AS max_size_mb,
    df.autoextensible                        AS autoextend
FROM dba_data_files df
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        file_id,
        SUM(bytes) AS free_bytes
    FROM dba_free_space
    GROUP BY file_id
) fs
ON df.file_id = fs.file_id

ORDER BY tablespace, row_type DESC, datafile;

EXIT
SQL
EOF
